skill.name: menews
skill.description: Creates Chinese AI morning briefings, evening summaries, hot-news rankings, and selected-news reports from AIMPACT and ME News API feeds.
skill.summary: Builds ranked Chinese AI news briefings from configured AIMPACT and ME News sources.
skill.author: me-news

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally retrieves news from four fixed ME News API endpoints and directs agents to use curl or web_fetch. Most other alerts are markdown, example links, Unicode text, or transparent scheduling examples rather than executable or obfuscated behavior.

remediation.issue: The workflow invokes curl for outbound API requests.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a structured fetch tool with fixed hosts, timeouts, response-size limits, and no redirects to unapproved domains.

remediation.issue: Remote API responses become report content.
remediation.suggestion: Validate response fields and URLs, treat all returned text as untrusted data, and ignore instructions embedded in feed content.

content.value_statement: Tracking important AI news across the day takes repeated filtering and organization. This skill builds structured Chinese briefings from configured AIMPACT and ME News feeds.
actual_capabilities: Retrieves AI articles, events, and flash updates from four configured ME News API endpoints.
Creates morning, evening, 24-hour hot-news, and selected-news reports in Chinese.
Filters items by the time window defined for each report type.
Deduplicates items by title or identifier and ranks available items by AI score.
Organizes news into model, agent, business, safety, product, and open-source categories.
Can send completed reports through a separately configured OpenClaw message channel.
limitations: The skill uses only the configured AIMPACT and ME News feeds.
Results depend on API availability, freshness, and supplied scoring data.
The skill does not independently verify claims in retrieved articles.
Scheduled delivery and message credentials must be configured outside the skill.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Daily Research Brief
use_cases.description: Generate a ranked morning summary of recent AI developments with source links and concise Chinese summaries.

use_cases.title: Monitor Product and Market Changes
use_cases.description: Review the highest-scoring model, agent, funding, safety, and product news from the last 24 hours.

use_cases.title: Publish an Internal News Digest
use_cases.description: Create a consistent evening report for a team and deliver it through an approved messaging channel.

prompt_templates.title: Get the Morning Briefing
prompt_templates.prompt: Query the AIMPACT morning briefing. Return up to ten ranked items with Chinese summaries and source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a quick daily overview.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Hot News
prompt_templates.prompt: Query the 24-hour hot-news ranking. Group the results by category and emphasize the five highest AI scores.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants the most influential recent stories.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Selected Categories
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an AI selected-news report for the last 24 hours. Prioritize agents, safety, and open-source releases while preserving source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: A specialist needs a focused report.

prompt_templates.title: Build and Deliver an Evening Digest
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the AIMPACT evening briefing, remove duplicate titles, rank by AI score, and send it through my configured message channel.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user has already approved and configured delivery.

best_practices: Review source links before sharing reports or making decisions.
Confirm the intended recipients and schedule before enabling message delivery.
Use the defined report type that matches the required time window.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated summaries as independent fact verification.
Do not add unapproved endpoints outside the configured source allowlist.
Do not enable scheduled delivery before testing the report and recipient configuration.

faq.question: Which news sources does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses four configured AIMPACT and ME News API feeds for AI articles, OpenClaw news, events, and flash updates.

faq.question: What report types are available?
faq.answer: It supports morning briefings, evening summaries, 24-hour hot-news rankings, and selected AI news reports.

faq.question: Does it search the public web?
faq.answer: No. The workflow restricts collection to the URLs listed in its source configuration.

faq.question: Can it deliver reports automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, but scheduling and the OpenClaw message channel must be configured separately with approved recipients and credentials.

faq.question: How are stories ranked?
faq.answer: The skill sorts by the AI score supplied by the API when that score is available.

faq.question: Does the skill verify every news claim?
faq.answer: No. Users should open the included source links and verify important claims independently.
